notes: All accuracies are percentages at the final recorded epoch. Each validation set contains 5,000 images, 500 per class.
Fractions and sparsities use the 0–1 scale. sweep_subset_fraction identifies the sweep; subset_fraction is null for full-data and data-free controls.
Identify a sparse measurement by (sweep_id, run_id). Separate sweeps can produce different measured accuracies for the same nominal control ID. Identical copies of dense baselines appear once.
Within each sweep and pruner, subset_mean_accuracy_pct is the average across subset runs, including random. Full-data and data-free controls have their own accuracy fields.
The interrupted 20% subset, 95% sparsity sweep has no additional saved validation results.
